title: The first Jan
message: Thawed, blinking, and already saying thank you. It begins.

title: Bigger pockets
message: A sled! Meagan can carry twice the logs and half the worry.

title: Proper fire
message: The furnace roars a little louder. The snow takes a step back.

title: A handful of Jans
message: Five Jans around one fire. It's starting to feel like a town.

title: Somewhere to keep things
message: A Storehouse. The Jans have already started labelling shelves.

title: Hammers going
message: The Workshop is open. Something is always being fixed now.

title: Weathered it
message: The first blizzard came and went. Everyone is still here, and warm.

title: Not today, wolves
message: The animals ran off with nothing. The Jans are unbearably proud.

title: Soup's on
message: A Chef Jan has arrived, ladle first.

title: Ten Jans
message: Ten of them. Meagan has started naming them in her head. They are all Jan.

title: Thinking hut
message: The Research Hut is built. Somebody has already pinned up a chart.

title: Eureka, mostly
message: The first discovery. The Jans insist it was a team effort.

title: Column A: Jan
message: A Spreadsheet Jan has arrived and is counting the other Jans.

title: Timber!
message: A Lumberjack Jan has turned up. The trees look nervous.

title: A real town
message: Furnace Lv 4. New buildings, new Jans, and the long nights are coming.

title: Five more minutes
message: A Sleepy Jan has arrived. He'll help. Soon.

title: Has anyone seen…
message: A Lost-His-Keys Jan has arrived, patting every pocket.

title: Twenty Jans
message: Twenty Jans. The furnace has never been so well attended.

title: Old hands
message: Five blizzards survived. Nobody even flinches at the wind now.

title: Fifty thawed
message: Meagan has thawed fifty Jans. Every one of them remembers it.

title: Lights in the snow
message: Furnace Lv 7. You can see the town's glow from the hills now.

title: Know-it-alls
message: Ten discoveries. The Research Hut needs a bigger blackboard.

title: A crowd of Jans
message: Forty Jans. Meagan could start a choir. They would all be tenors.

title: Every Jan accounted for
message: The full collection. Meagan has met every Jan there is.

title: The thaw is coming
message: Furnace Lv 10. Somewhere, a bird is thinking about spring.

title: Write me
message: The secret milestone: set unlockDate to the date that matters (YYYY-MM-DD) and write the message.
